label: RequestPlan
payload: Please prepare an implementation plan for the standard-revenue feature: include requirements, design approach, task breakdown, estimated effort, test cases, and deployment steps.

label: PlanReady
payload:
Implementation Plan: standard-revenue feature

1) Summary
- Introduce a standardized revenue model across products to unify revenue calculation, storage, reporting, and APIs. Backwards-compatible where possible; gated behind a feature flag for gradual rollout.

2) Requirements
- Functional
  - Calculate and store standardized revenue per transaction (fields: revenue_amount, currency, revenue_type, recognized_date, source_id).
  - Expose revenue via new/extended APIs for read/write where applicable.
  - Provide migration path for existing revenue fields to the new schema.
  - Support multi-currency and basic FX conversion metadata (conversion_rate, base_currency).
  - Admin UI to view/override standardized revenue; opt-in toggle per account.
- Non-functional
  - Data consistency and ACID for revenue writes.
  - Backwards compatibility for existing clients until migration complete.
  - Audit trail for revenue changes.

3) Design approach
- Architecture
  - Backend service changes in Revenue domain (or new microservice module) to centralize revenue logic.
  - Shared library for revenue calculation (used by services that record revenue).
  - DB: introduce new table/columns (e.g., revenue_records) + migration scripts for legacy tables.
- Data model (high level)
  - revenue_records: id, entity_id, entity_type, revenue_amount_minor, currency, revenue_type, recognized_date, source_service, created_at, updated_at, migrated_from, audit_metadata
- API changes
  - POST /v2/revenue (create standardized revenue) - permissioned
  - GET /v2/revenue?entity_id=... (query)
  - PATCH /v2/revenue/{id} (admin override with audit)
  - Maintain existing endpoints; map legacy fields to new model internally until migration completes.
- UI
  - Admin page listing standardized revenue; per-account toggle to enable feature; manual reconciliation UI for migrated records.
- Feature flagging
  - Gate writes behind a server-side feature flag; reads optionally map both legacy and standardized model.
- Migration strategy
  - Read-only migration job to backfill standardized records from legacy revenue fields (batch/streaming)
  - Validate migrated data with checksum sampling before switching writes.
- Observability & Monitoring
  - Metrics: revenue_ingest_rate, migration_progress, failed_migrations, revenue_discrepancies
  - Logging and audit trail for all writes/overrides.

4) Task breakdown & estimates (effort given in person-days and hours ranges)
- Phase A: Design & spec (2-3 days)
  - Finalize data model, APIs, and migration approach — 2d (16h)
  - Security & permissions review — 0.5d (4h)
- Phase B: Backend implementation (10-14 days)
  - Implement revenue_records schema + DB migrations (DDL + migration scripts) — 2d (16h)
  - Implement revenue service logic & shared calc library — 4d (32h)
  - API endpoints (POST/GET/PATCH) + validation + auth — 3d (24h)
  - Audit logging and metrics hooks — 1d (8h)
- Phase C: Data migration (4-6 days)
  - Build migration jobs (batch/streaming), idempotent and resumable — 3d (24h)
  - Run sample migration, reconciliation scripts, fix issues — 2d (16h)
- Phase D: Frontend/admin changes (3-5 days)
  - Admin UI: list, toggle, overrides — 2d (16h)
  - Integrate with feature flag control panel — 0.5d (4h)
  - Minor UX polish and accessibility checks — 0.5d (4h)
- Phase E: Testing & QA (3-5 days)
  - Unit tests for calc library and API — 1.5d (12h)
  - Integration tests for end-to-end flow — 1.5d (12h)
  - Data migration validation and reconciliation tests — 1d (8h)
- Phase F: Rollout & deployment (1-2 days)
  - Staging deployment and smoke tests — 0.5d (4h)
  - Production deployment with feature flag gating + run migration — 0.5d (4h)
  - Post-deploy monitoring and roll-back plan — 0.5d (4h)

Estimated total: ~26-33 person-days (~208-264 hours). (Adjustable: if migration complexity is low, lower bound ~20 days.)

5) Test cases (high level)
- Unit tests
  - revenue calculation with various inputs (discounts, taxes, multi-currency)
  - validation errors for malformed requests
- Integration tests
  - Create revenue record via API, verify persisted schema and audit metadata
  - Update override via PATCH, verify audit trail
  - API read returns combined/legacy-compatible responses
- Migration tests
  - Batch job migrates sample dataset, counts match source, spot-check value-level equivalence
  - Idempotency: rerunning migration does not create duplicates
- E2E (BrowserTester)
  - Admin toggles feature flag for an account, creates transactions, verifies standardized revenue appears
  - Reconciliation scenario: migrated vs newly created revenue comparison
- Load & safety
  - Run migration job in staging at production-scale cadence; ensure DB locks and throughput acceptable

6) Deployment steps
- Pre-deploy
  - Code review & security checks completed
  - Database migration script reviewed and tested on staging snapshot
  - Create feature flag and default off for production
  - Backups taken of affected DBs
- Staging
  - Deploy services and run full migration on staging dataset
  - Run full test suite and manual reconciliation checks
- Production rollout (gated)
  - Deploy backend and DB schema changes (non-destructive parts first)
  - Enable feature flag for a small pilot account set
  - Run migration for pilot accounts; check metrics and reconciliation
  - Gradually increase rollout (canary -> 25% -> 100%) while monitoring
  - When confident, flip default flag and deprecate legacy fields per schedule
- Rollback plan
  - If issues, disable feature flag (stops new writes to standardized model)
  - Restore from backup if migration corrupted source data (rare; migration should be read-only until final cutover)
- Post-deploy
  - Run reconciliation job to ensure parity across datasets
  - Remove legacy code paths after full cutover and communicated deprecation window

7) Risks & mitigations
- Data mismatch risk: add checksum sampling and reconcile tool; run pilot migration
- DB migration locks: use online-safe migrations and chunked backfills
- Client compatibility: keep old endpoints working and provide migration docs

8) Deliverables
- Schema migration scripts, migration tool, tests
- New/updated APIs and shared calc library
- Admin UI and feature flag control
- Deployment runbook and rollback procedures

Requested next steps: please have Reviewer review this plan. I can replan after test failure or review feedback.
